# Gift Advisor Acceptance

- Discovery asks about observable recipient behavior before product categories.
- Unknown answers create no preference signal.
- Facts, cautious inferences, and unknowns remain separate.
- The recommendation set represents at least two strategies and contains no duplicate product family.
- Every numeric price remains within the declared budget.
- Every recommendation includes one verified public HTTPS product page, real product image from that page, visible listed price, availability note, publisher, and check date.
- The committed example is deterministic, responsive, loads no remote executable resource, and is generated by `gift-advisor-report` v1.
- Visual and interaction acceptance remains user-owned.
